label: Confirm dialog
description: A modal dialog that asks the viewer to confirm an action that is destructive or hard to undo, such as cancelling a ticket. Use it sparingly; prefer optimistic actions with an Undo toast for reversible changes.
usage: Title the dialog as a question ("Cancel this ticket?").
Label the confirm button with the action itself ("Cancel ticket"), never "OK" or "Yes".
Explain the consequence in the text (who is notified, what cannot be undone).
constraints: title (at most 80), text (at most 300), and confirmLabel (at most 30) are required.
tone danger renders a danger confirm button and puts initial focus on Cancel.

binding.description: App-level pattern raised by the platform and elements, not placed in views.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab is trapped in the dialog; Esc cancels; Enter on a button activates it. Focus returns to the invoking control on close.
accessibility.notes: Labelled by the title and described by the text. Initial focus is Confirm for neutral and Cancel for danger.

responsive: Centered dialog up to 480px wide; full-width bottom sheet below 720px.

props.title: Cancel this ticket?
props.text: The requester is notified and the ticket can no longer be worked.
